claims.rationale: Product code exists and is runnable

claims.evidence: .codex-factory/ with 8 files updated across 9 stages, recovery drill passed
claims.rationale: Memory was initialized, updated, and recoverable

claims.evidence: Quick Mode found 1 warning (default JWT secret) among 12 checks

claims.claim: Build Mode solves all complex projects
claims.evidence: BUILD-3 tested ONE project (DevFlow, MEDIUM complexity). No evidence for LARGE, HIGH_RISK, or multi-agent projects.
BUILD-3 used BUILD_LITE (single-agent). No multi-agent trial completed.
Only one BUILD trial completed. No multi-agent trial. No benchmark comparison.
Used in one 2-session equivalent trial. Not tested across >3 sessions or with multi-agent coordination.
